data.subject: PCB, RBB, CFBK public-record research
data.body:
Hi,

Rhino Investment Partners’ most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCB, RBB, and CFBK.

On September 24, 2026, PCB disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1423869/000142386926000029/pcb-20260923.htm)

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot.

Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
